routeSelection.basis: Registry resolution case rc-0074 (normalization status step2-resolved-split) explicitly identifies cp-000113 as the Dutch-taught 'Nationale Politiek en Bestuur' track/version of the shared VU Political Science registration, distinct from the English 'Global Politics' track (cp-000112); the registry's own targets metadata records {"language":"NLD","focus":"national politics and governance"} for this exact target. OER Article 10.2 confirms that, starting cohort 2025-2026, the bachelor's programme (RIO 56606) offers exactly two named tracks -- 'Politicologie: Nationale Politiek en Bestuur' (Dutch) and 'Political Science: Global Politics' (English) -- so the normalized target itself names this exact official route (Section 2.1 rule 1), confirmed by current official evidence for the 2026-2027 academic year and by the Dutch-language 'politicologie' curriculum, overview and future/career webpages themselves, and by Article 10.4's confirmation that Dutch is the track's language of instruction.

audience.programmeDescription: VU National Politics and Government studies how political power and public administration work in the Netherlands. Students examine democracy, the welfare state, Europe, economics and political theory, and learn quantitative and qualitative research alongside writing and debate.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A complete comparison is awaiting verified curriculum information for students entering the new curriculum from 2025–2026. The confirmed subset below contains 120 EC across the first two years and at least 30 EC of open study. The third-year course credits and thesis allocation need confirmation, so no UCR alternative is presented. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.
